name: Feign Innocence
body:
Feign Innocence (Ex)
Source Ultimate Intrigue pg. 11
The vigilante’s social identity seems so innocent that it is hard to believe he was involved in wrongdoing. Within his area of renown, this provides a nonmagical effect identical to the innocenceAPG spell. A vigilante must be at least 5th level and have the renown social talent to take this talent.
